heading: Waiver of mediation rights by borrowers
lead: The Secretary may not make, insure, or guarantee any farmer program loan to a farm borrower on the condition that the borrower waive any right under the mediation program of any State.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1994—Pub. L. 103–354 struck out “agricultural loan” before “mediation program”.
